name: Cross ~Kyouki e no Michishirube~
source:
Main character is a school hooligan. He finds an interest in the humiliation game and wants to recreate it in the real world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
身为校园不良少年的男主角迷上了一款凌辱调教游戏，并萌生了在现实世界中亲手重现游戏内容的危险念头。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
